units: Native pixel Chebyshev distance; dimensionless area and moment shares/enrichment. RGB channels, not CFA phases.
limitations: Association with outcome, not counterfactual causal contribution. Frozen masks selected on development; prior inspection of control still limits blindness. Toroidal shifted controls can overlap sites and introduce wrapping; deterministic descriptive references, no pvalues. Crop border truncates neighborhoods, union of phases not channel-specific. No pixel modification, denoising or visual quality validation; same dark session only.
